# Version 4.154.0
> **Documentation and m154** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates to Skia m154 and delivers compiler XML documentation with regenerated HarfBuzz bindings. HarfBuzzSharp corrects one enum name and removes an aggregate mask member; review the migration notes if you use those APIs.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was renamed** — The corrected upstream name is UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC132, with the same numeric value of 132. Replace CCC133 with CCC132 in source code. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **GlyphFlags.Defined was removed** — The aggregate mask no longer appears in HarfBuzzSharp. Combine the concrete flags your application requires instead of using GlyphFlags.Defined. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 154 and incorporates its upstream rendering fixes. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945), [#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))

## API Surface

- **Compiler XML documentation ships with packages** — API documentation now comes from C# XML comments and is packaged beside managed assemblies for IDE consumers. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

HarfBuzzSharp bindings are now generated from the bundled native source, keeping ordinary APIs synchronized while correcting the Unicode combining-class name and removing aggregate flag masks.
